Back exercisesMy back dayPush exercises

37 back exercises that fit the equipment in your building's gym. Each one shows the start and end position. Breathe out as you pull, and don't hold your breath.

You already do thisArms overhead: careful with your shoulderHeavy on the lower back: start lightEasy on shoulder and back

Pull-up bar (top of the big black cable tower)

Mostly the wide 'wing' muscles under your arms (lats).

1Pull-up

Palms facing away, hands about shoulder width (not wide like in the picture). Pull your chest up to the bar.

You already do thisArms overhead: careful with your shoulder

2Chin-up

Palms face you, hands close together. Pull your chin over the bar.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

Lat pulldown machine (grey machine with knee pads and the long bar)

Like a pull-up, but you choose the weight.

3Close-grip pulldown

Hands about shoulder width on the bar. Pull to your chest, lean back a little.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

4Palms-up pulldown

Palms facing you. Pull the bar to your chest. Hits the lower lats.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

5V-handle pulldown

Clip on the V handle. Pull it down to your chest.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

6One-arm pulldown

One handle, one arm. Pull your elbow down to your side. Good if one side is weaker.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

7Rope straight-arm pulldown

Same as above with the rope handle.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

Cable tower (big black frame with two adjustable cables)

Rows for the middle of your back, and the small muscles behind your shoulders.

8Chest-height cable row

Set the cable at chest height. Stand and pull the handle to your chest.

Easy on shoulder and back

9Standing one-arm cable row

Stand, cable low. Pull one handle to your hip, palm turning up.

Easy on shoulder and back

10Kneeling high cable row

Cable at the top. Kneel and pull the rope or bar toward your face.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

11Kneeling one-arm high row

Same, one arm. Pull your elbow down and back.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

12Face pull

Rope at face height. Pull the rope ends toward your ears. Very good for shoulder health.

Easy on shoulder and back

13Cable reverse fly

Cables at shoulder height, crossed. Pull your arms wide like opening a big hug.

Easy on shoulder and back

Dumbbells, kettlebells and benches

Free-weight rows. You already know the first one.

14One-arm dumbbell row

One knee and one hand on the bench (the 'cow' position). Pull the dumbbell to your hip.

You already do this

15Chest-down dumbbell row

Tilt a bench up (if yours goes high enough), lie chest-down on it and row two dumbbells up. Your lower back does no work.

Easy on shoulder and back

16Bent-over two-dumbbell row

Stand, bend forward with a flat back. Row both dumbbells to your belly.

17Bent-over row, palms in

Same, palms facing each other.

18Bent-over reverse fly

Stand bent forward. Raise light dumbbells out to the side.

19Dumbbell pullover

Lie across the bench. Lower one dumbbell behind your head, then pull it back over your chest.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

20One-arm kettlebell row

Like the dumbbell row, with a kettlebell.

21Two-arm kettlebell row

Bend forward and row two kettlebells.

22Alternating kettlebell row

Bend forward, row one kettlebell, then the other.

Barbell, deadlift platform and squat rack

Heavy lifts for your whole back. Start light.

23Bent-over barbell row

Stand, bend forward with a flat back. Pull the barbell to your belly.

Heavy on the lower back: start light

24Palms-up barbell row

Same, with palms facing up.

Heavy on the lower back: start light

25Corner barbell row (T-bar)

Put one end of the bar in a corner. Stand over the other end and row it to your chest.

Heavy on the lower back: start light

26One-arm corner barbell row

Same, one hand on the end of the bar.

Heavy on the lower back: start light

27Hex-bar deadlift

Stand inside the hexagon bar. Stand up holding the side handles. Easier on the back than a straight bar.

Heavy on the lower back: start light

28Deadlift

Bar over your feet. With a flat back, stand up holding the bar.

Heavy on the lower back: start light

29Rack pull (half deadlift)

Bar resting on the rack pins at knee height. Stand up with it.

Heavy on the lower back: start light

30Romanian deadlift

Hold the bar standing. Push your hips back and slide the bar down to your knees, then stand.

Heavy on the lower back: start light

Smith machine (the bar that slides up and down in the cable tower)

The bar is on rails, so it's steadier and safer.

31Smith machine row

Bend forward and row the Smith bar to your belly.

Heavy on the lower back: start light

32Body row (upside-down row)

Set the Smith bar at waist height. Hang under it, body straight, and pull your chest up. Lower bar = harder.

Easy on shoulder and back

Lower back, no machine (floor and exercise ball)

For the muscles along your spine.

33Superman

Lie face down. Lift your arms and legs a little off the floor. Hold 2 seconds.

Easy on shoulder and back

34Exercise-ball back raise

Lie face down over the big ball, feet against the wall. Lift your chest up.

Easy on shoulder and back

35Glute bridge

Lie on your back, knees bent. Lift your hips up.

Easy on shoulder and back

Stretches (after your workout)

Hold each one for 20 to 30 seconds.

36Child's pose

Kneel, sit back on your heels, reach your arms forward on the floor.

Easy on shoulder and back

37Lat stretch on a wall

Hold a pole or the rack at waist height and sit your hips back.

Easy on shoulder and back

Your back day, in order. 3 sets of 8 to 12 unless it says otherwise. Breathe out as you pull, and don't hold your breath.

Warm-up

Before you start. Slow and easy, 30 seconds each.

Arm circles

Arms out to the sides. Small circles forward, then backward. Make them a little bigger as you go.

Easy on shoulder and back

Shoulder rolls

Arms down. Roll your shoulders up, back and down, 10 times.

Easy on shoulder and back

1 · Deadlift

Platform

First, while you are fresh. Do 1 or 2 light sets with an easy weight before your real sets.

Deadlift

3 sets of 5 to 8

Bar over your feet. With a flat back, stand up holding the bar.

Heavy on the lower back: start light

2 · Pull-ups

Pull-up bar

Normal grip, hands about shoulder width. Never wide.

Pull-up

3 sets, as many as you can do well

Palms facing away, hands about shoulder width (not wide like in the picture). Pull your chest up to the bar.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

3 · Cable row

Cable tower

Chest-height cable row

3 sets of 10 to 12

Set the cable at chest height. Stand and pull the handle to your chest.

Easy on shoulder and back

4 · Lat pulldown

Pulldown machine

Same machine, same weight pin. Only your grip changes.

Close-grip pulldown

First: 3 sets of 8 to 12, close grip

Hands about shoulder width on the bar. Pull to your chest, lean back a little.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

Palms-up pulldown

Then: 2 to 3 sets of 8 to 12, palms up

Palms facing you. Pull the bar to your chest. Hits the lower lats.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

5 · One-arm dumbbell row

Dumbbells

The one you already do.

One-arm dumbbell row

3 sets of 8 to 12 each arm

One knee and one hand on the bench (the 'cow' position). Pull the dumbbell to your hip.

You already do this

Bonus

Optional

Extra if you have time and energy. Pick any. If the cable machine is busy, skip the cable ones.

Rope straight-arm pulldown

3 sets of 10 to 12 (cable tower)

Same as above with the rope handle.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

Kneeling high cable row

3 sets of 10 to 12 (cable tower)

Cable at the top. Kneel and pull the rope or bar toward your face.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

Bent-over reverse fly

3 sets of 12 to 15, light dumbbells

Stand bent forward. Raise light dumbbells out to the side.

Dumbbell pullover

3 sets of 10 to 12. Go light; stop if your shoulder hurts

Lie across the bench. Lower one dumbbell behind your head, then pull it back over your chest.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

Corner barbell row (T-bar)

3 sets of 8 to 10. One end of the bar in a corner

Put one end of the bar in a corner. Stand over the other end and row it to your chest.

Heavy on the lower back: start light

Finish

Hold each stretch for 20 to 30 seconds.

Glute bridge

2 sets of 12

Lie on your back, knees bent. Lift your hips up.

Easy on shoulder and back

Lat stretch on a wall

30 seconds each side

Hold a pole or the rack at waist height and sit your hips back.

Easy on shoulder and back

Child's pose

30 to 60 seconds

Kneel, sit back on your heels, reach your arms forward on the floor.

21 chest, shoulder and triceps exercises that fit the equipment in your building's gym. Each one shows the start and end position. Breathe out as you push, and don't hold your breath. No wide grips, for your shoulder.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulderEasy on shoulder and back

Bench press station (flat grey bench with bar holders)

The main chest builders. Hands a little wider than your shoulders, never very wide.

1Bench press

Lie on the flat bench. Lower the bar to the middle of your chest, then push it up.

2Close-grip bench press

Hands at shoulder width. Elbows stay close to your body. Chest and the back of your arms.

Easy on shoulder and back

Dumbbells and a flat bench

Each arm works on its own, and you can turn your hands to whatever feels best for your shoulder.

3Dumbbell bench press

Lie flat. Push both dumbbells up over your chest, then lower them slowly.

4Dumbbell press, palms facing in

Same, but palms face each other. The kindest press for your shoulder.

Easy on shoulder and back

5One-arm dumbbell press

One dumbbell, one arm at a time. Your stomach works to keep you steady.

Cable tower (big black frame with two adjustable cables)

Steady pull the whole way. Good finishers.

6Standing cable press

Cables at chest height behind you. Step forward and push both handles straight out in front.

Easy on shoulder and back

7Cable fly, low to high

Cables low. Bring the handles up and together in front of your chest. Upper chest.

Easy on shoulder and back

8One-arm cable fly

One handle at a time across your body.

Smith machine (the bar on rails in the black cable tower)

The bar can't fall sideways, so it's safer when you train alone.

9Smith bench press

Put a flat bench under the bar. Lower to your chest, push up.

Floor

No machine needed.

10Push-up

Hands under your shoulders, body straight. Lower your chest to the floor, push up.

Shoulders (pushing up)

Pressing straight up over your head.

11Seated dumbbell shoulder press

Sit with the bench upright. Push the dumbbells up over your head.

12One-arm press, palm in

Stand. Palm facing in, push one dumbbell up. Kinder to the shoulder than palms forward.

13Smith shoulder press

Sit on an upright bench under the Smith bar. Push the bar up from your chin.

14Front raise

Lift one light dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height.

Triceps (back of the arm)

Every press uses these. Finish your push day with one or two.

15Rope pushdown

Rope on the high cable. Elbows at your sides. Push the rope down and pull the ends apart.

Easy on shoulder and back

16Bar pushdown

Same with the short bar.

Easy on shoulder and back

17Palms-up pushdown

Bar on the high cable, palms facing up.

Easy on shoulder and back

18Overhead rope extension

Face away from the cable, rope behind your head. Straighten your arms forward.

Arms overhead: careful with your shoulder

19Lying dumbbell extension

Lie on the bench, dumbbells up. Bend only at the elbow to lower them beside your head, then straighten.

20Dumbbell kickback

Bend forward, elbow at your side. Straighten your arm back.

Easy on shoulder and back

21Close-grip dumbbell press

Lie flat, dumbbells touching. Press up.

Easy on shoulder and back
